question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $v$ shown above. Which of the following statements are true?

I. $v$ is an eigenvector corresponding to the eigenvalue $\lambda =1$ of $A$

II. $v$ is a generalized eigenvector of rank $3$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\lambda =1$ of $A$

III. $v$ is a generalized eigenvector of rank $2$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\lambda =1$ of $A$

choices.value: None of thee statements are true
